negative_snippets:
One of the worst nightmares of my life. I booked this via MMT to rest for a couple of hours before my flight. Turns out, not only is the hotel nothing like what’s shown in the pictures but also the staff behaviour is utmost disrespectful and rogue.
My booking was from 6-9am and I was let in my room at 7am because the staff member was not able to find my booking itself. I entered the room only to find it dirty to an extreme that will fall short of words. Somehow I passed the time and went down to checkout at 10am (because I had paid for 3 hours and my check in was done at 7am). At the reception, the lady started asking me for extra money for 1 hour because according to her my check out was at 9am. When I told them about my late check in, she shrugged and told me to give money or she will misuse my Aadhar copy. In her words - “Mere pass apke IDs hain dekh lo”.
I hope this reaches the right people and a strict action is taken against such ridiculous, incompetent staff.

Worst experience ever!!! Had to book a hotel in emergency but never thought it would be this unhygienic and dirty. The staff are unresponsive and inattentive. The washroom is in terrible condition, better that you dont use it at all. Even the room is not worth the price and use. I just booked it to get ready for a function but even that duration was very difficult to endure. No soap or towels are provided. The geyser doesn't work.

The worst and dirty hotel I ever visited.. they have rooms available in 1 and 2 floor but they gave us 4th floor 402 room. Lift was not working, That room was horrible, a 🪱 worm is running on bed and full of the room was filled with mosquitos. When we told them about the room, receptionist just ignore all and said are you leaving or staying.
